title: Illegal immigration; procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal aliens provided for; reporting requirements established
description: Illegal immigration; procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal aliens provided for; reporting requirements established
plain_english_change: The law now says that if ICE sends a detainer or warrant, the jail can hold someone for up to 48 hours. If no federal judge signs it within that time, they must release them unless there's another valid reason like citizenship proof.
yea_policy_effect: Jails can hold people for up to 48 hours on ICE detainers without a judge-signed warrant; must notify consulates and verify status of foreign nationals.
evidence_quotes: ['(8)a. Inmates shall be held no longer than 48 hours pursuant to an immigration detainer or an immigration warrant...', 'An immigration warrant signed by any immigration official other than a federal judge or federal magistrate shall be treated as an immigration detainer.', 'If an immigration warrant... is not received by the jail staff within 48 hours, or if ICE does not take custody of the inmate within 48 hours, the inmate shall be eligible for release from the custody.']

vote_description: Third Reading in House of Origin
title: Illegal immigration; procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal aliens provided for; reporting requirements established
description: Illegal immigration; procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal aliens provided for; reporting requirements established
plain_english_change: This bill introduces several changes to Alabama's laws regarding the handling of foreign nationals in county and municipal jails. Here are the key points in plain English:
yea_policy_effect: The bill is likely to have a restrictive effect on immigration policies by mandating stricter verification and detention procedures for foreign nationals in jails.
evidence_quotes: ['The bill requires that jails verify the legal status of suspected foreign nationals upon admission, using specific documents or contacting LESC/ICE for verification.', 'It mandates that jails honor immigration detainers and warrants issued by ICE unless they are signed by a federal judge or magistrate within 48 hours.', 'Jails must maintain records of all communications with ICE regarding foreign nationals.', 'The bill also requires quarterly reports on the number of foreign national inmates, inquiries made to LESC/ICE, responses indicating unlawful status, and immigration detainers issued.']
review_reason: This bill introduces significant changes in how Alabama handles foreign nationals within its jails. It is crucial for human review to ensure compliance with federal laws and constitutional rights, particularly concerning due process and the treatment of individuals based on their immigration status.
